# Hootsuite

> Hootsuite is a comprehensive social media management platform combining content scheduling, analytics, listening, and reputation management across 150+ integrations.

Hootsuite serves enterprises and teams across financial services, government, healthcare, education, and professional services with AI-powered tools for social media strategy, crisis management, and employee advocacy. The platform integrates with major networks including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Twitter/X, and YouTube.

## Key Topics

- Social Media Management
- Social Listening
- Sentiment Analysis
- Crisis Management
- Reputation Management
- Content Scheduling
- Social Media Analytics
- Employee Advocacy
- Brand Monitoring
- Real-Time Alerts
- Competitor Tracking
- Media Monitoring
- Review Management
- ROI Tracking
- Talkwalker AI Integration

## Core Platform & Features

- [Hootsuite Platform Overview](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform): Hootsuite platform overview with 20+ network management, AI writing, and publishing features.
- [Social Media Publishing & Scheduling](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/publishing): Social media content calendar and scheduling with AI writing and Canva/Adobe Express integration.
- [Social Media Inbox](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/social-media-inbox): Unified inbox for managing messages across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp with team collaboration.
- [Social Media Analytics](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/analytics): Multi-platform analytics dashboard for performance metrics, engagement tracking, and competitive analysis.
- [Social Media ROI Tracking](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/social-media-roi): Social media ROI tracking with Advanced Analytics and Google/Adobe Analytics integration.
- [Integrations & Connected Apps](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/integrations): 150+ app integrations with major social networks including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube.

## Listening, Monitoring & Protection

- [Social Listening & Monitoring](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/listening): Hootsuite social listening platform for brand monitoring, sentiment analysis, and competitor tracking.
- [Reputation Management](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/reputation-management): Reputation management with real-time alerts, sentiment analysis, and competitive insights via Talkwalker AI.
- [Crisis Management & Detection](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/crisis-management): Crisis detection and management with real-time sentiment monitoring and coordinated response tools.
- [Media Monitoring](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/media-monitoring): Real-time media monitoring across channels with sentiment analysis and competitor tracking.
- [Review Management](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/review-management): AI-powered review management across 300+ sites with sentiment analysis and trend detection.

## Employee Advocacy & Amplification

- [Hootsuite Amplify Employee Advocacy](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/employee-advocacy): Hootsuite Amplify employee advocacy tool for boosting engagement and brand reach via employee sharing.

## Industry Solutions

- [Financial Services](https://www.hootsuite.com/industries/financial-services): Hootsuite solution for financial services with compliance, employee advocacy, and security features.
- [Government & Public Agencies](https://www.hootsuite.com/industries/government): FedRAMP-compliant Hootsuite for government agencies with sentiment analysis and monitoring.
- [Healthcare & Medical](https://www.hootsuite.com/industries/healthcare): HIPAA-compliant Hootsuite for healthcare with patient engagement and crisis communication tools.
- [Higher Education](https://www.hootsuite.com/industries/higher-education): Hootsuite Enterprise for universities enabling student engagement, recruitment, and campus communications.
- [Real Estate & Builders](https://www.hootsuite.com/industries/real-estate): Hootsuite for real estate professionals with lead generation and employee advocacy capabilities.
- [Professional Services](https://www.hootsuite.com/industries/professional-services): Hootsuite for professional services with employee advocacy, analytics, and sentiment analysis.
- [Legal & Law Firms](https://www.hootsuite.com/industries/legal): Hootsuite for law firms with compliance, employee advocacy, and thought leadership tools.
